name: tuneitverse
description: TuneItVerse - open ECU tuning platform. Offline BIN/XDF/A2L tools, per-family capability status with sources. Experimental P01 write off by default and not bench-tested. EDC16 checksum report-only. v3.48.0 adds Maps table CSV export.

scripts.build:innosetup: tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && iscc installer\TuneItVerse.iss && node scripts/copy-installer.js
